title: DNI team encounters orbs at western US military base
place_text: US military installation, western United States

tellings.quote: UAPs. So they jump in the helicopter, they go to the location and what they interact with are basically glowing orbs.

plain: Around 2025 or 2026, a team working for Tulsi Gabbard, the Director of National Intelligence (the head of all US spy agencies), flew by helicopter to a spot on a military base in the western United States and found themselves dealing with glowing orbs. Congressman Eric Burlison tells it, linking it to the government's recent releases on UAP, its term for UFOs. If true, it means top intelligence staff have met these things up close.
